inputs.original_text: The judge’s block is being sold as a defense of religious freedom, but that framing conveniently pushes the unborn lives at stake out of view. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice supplied the argument, and the institutions’ version of events turns any limit on abortion into oppression. That looks less like neutral principle than a coordinated effort to control which part of the story people notice—and which concerns they’re told to dismiss.
inputs.modified_text: This is a fight over who gets to control the narrative. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice are presenting the judge’s block as religious freedom, while the institutions behind that framing keep the unborn out of sight and cast every abortion limit as oppression. That selective focus doesn’t look neutral—it looks like a coordinated way to steer public attention and make people dismiss the concerns that challenge their agenda.
